UPDATE projects 
SET seoKeywords = 'Greek comedy, Lysistrata, theatrical design, classical theatre, 2021'
WHERE title = 'Lysistrata';

UPDATE projects 
SET seoKeywords = 'mid-century modern, retail design, concept rendering, Park and Shop, heritage design'
